policy_unchanged_during_analysis.note: Lateral/overlap/perimeter are declared trial policies, not physical laws. The explicit lateral fraction permits a bounded contact experiment, not a material-feasibility claim. The 5 mm minimum teddy/left-robot clearance is an engineering preflight allowance, not a physical law. Bottom clearance and lateral trial fraction are configurable; no compression is prescribed.

geometry_not_material_law: Lateral excursion fraction and overlap ratio only select a bounded experiment; they do not constitute material deformation limits. Perimeter is a necessary envelope allowance, not proof of 3D or coupled deformable passage.

left_robot_sweep.model_scope: continuous frozen tetrahedral body versus MuJoCo convex collision solids
limitations: Does not predict deformation, friction, grasp retention or contact forces.
Robot convex envelopes can overestimate nonconvex native collision surfaces.
Left pose is fixed at measured q; native affine compliance and future tracking are not included.
Only the declared vertical segment is certified; raise/XY transport and other obstacles require separate gates.
A fresh actual-shape check remains necessary after physical preparation.
